metadata.title: NowCoding Cloud
metadata.description: Official NowCoding profiles, SVG cards, and Arena leaderboard for AI coding activity.

home.title: NowCoding Cloud
home.headline: See what builders are coding with AI right now.
home.description: NowCoding turns AI coding activity into a live profile, shareable status card, and social proof across GitHub and the open web.

liveBuilders.label: Live builders
liveBuilders.headline: Builders active right now
liveBuilders.emptyDescription: Connect the CLI and start broadcasting to populate the live feed. No prompts, code, or completions are uploaded.

capabilities.label: Cloud capabilities
capabilities.headline: Profiles, ranking, and privacy stay separate.
capabilities.description: Verified activity powers public profiles, ranking only happens by consent, and sensitive development content stays out of uploads.
capabilities.currentProject: Publish a shareable profile page and SVG card from verified CLI uploads.
capabilities.arena: Join the official leaderboard only after opt-in consent, with anti-abuse checks and admin review.

privacy.noPrivateContent: No prompts, code, or completions are uploaded.

usage.title: Usage
usage.headline: Signals behind current activity
usage.description: Usage data explains the activity that powers profiles and sharing surfaces.
usage.signInDescription: Sign in with GitHub to view the signals behind your public NowCoding presence.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.headline: Current momentum across the community
leaderboard.description: Rankings show visible activity without changing the underlying scoring contract.
leaderboard.emptyDescription: The database is ready. Once users sign in, confirm a CLI device, and upload accepted activity, Arena entries will be generated here.

profile.title: Profile
profile.headline: A shareable view of now
profile.description: User pages turn current coding activity into a social presence.

onboarding.title: Onboarding
onboarding.headline: Start publishing your Now
onboarding.description: Connect a device and make current activity visible on your profile.
onboarding.signInRequiredStatus: Sign in with GitHub to update onboarding settings.
onboarding.name: Name
onboarding.arenaHelp: Arena controls whether eligible profile and leaderboard data can be public.
onboarding.automaticSyncHelp: Install and start the daemon to keep Cloud usage current.

account.settingsSignInDescription: Sign in with GitHub to manage your NowCoding Cloud account and CLI devices.
account.settingsDescription: Manage your browser session, public identity, and connected CLI devices.
account.identityDescription: This is the GitHub identity currently attached to your browser session.
account.accountPagesDescription: Review connected devices or read the public data policy.
account.devicesSignInDescription: Sign in with GitHub to review and manage CLI devices connected to your account.
account.devicesDescription: Rename devices you recognize and revoke access for old or unknown CLI installs. Revoked devices are removed from this active list but kept in security history.
account.deviceRevoked: Device revoked and removed from authorized devices.
account.deviceInvalid: Enter a device name before saving.
account.renameFailed: The device could not be renamed.
account.revokeFailed: The device could not be revoked.
account.noDevicesDescription: Connect the NowCoding CLI to authorize a device for secure account uploads.

loginDevice.title: Device login
loginDevice.headline: Connect this device
loginDevice.description: Authorize the CLI so your activity can update your Cloud profile.

deviceLogin.deviceCodeMissing: The device code was not found or has already been used.
deviceLogin.githubExpired: Sign in with GitHub again before confirming your device.
deviceLogin.joinLeaderboardHelp: Arena can publish your GitHub profile, leaderboard rank, token totals, estimated cost, active time, and usage summaries from uploaded NowCoding activity.
deviceLogin.authorizedTerminal: NowCoding CLI is authorized. Return to your terminal while Cloud checks the setup status.
deviceLogin.reviewSetup: If the terminal does not continue automatically, open onboarding to review your device, first sync, Arena, profile links, and automatic sync status.
deviceLogin.authorizedReturn: NowCoding CLI is authorized. You can return to your terminal.
deviceLogin.enterDeviceCode: Enter the device code shown by the NowCoding CLI.
deviceLogin.startFromTerminal: Start device login from your terminal, or enter a device code manually.
